roles.PRIMARY: pre-specified and sufficiently reliable for scientific decision
roles.DESCRIPTIVE: recorded for exploration/sensitivity but not authorized to carry the primary claim
roles.EXCLUDED: unavailable, contaminated, semantically incomparable, or explicitly out of scope

gate: require at least one PRIMARY objective
if any PRIMARY objective is missing from either capacity observation set -> INSTRUMENTATION_HOLD
compute PRIMARY + available DESCRIPTIVE sensitivity projection separately
never silently fill missing objectives with zero
never add EXCLUDED objectives to sensitivity projection

classifications.NO_MEASURED_MONOTONICITY_VIOLATION: no frontier loss in the primary or descriptive extension
classifications.PROJECTION_FRAGILE: no primary loss, but a loss appears after adding descriptive objectives
classifications.PRIMARY_VIOLATION_STABLE_TO_DESCRIPTIVE_: primary frontier loss remains the same after descriptive extension
classifications.PRIMARY_VIOLATION_PROJECTION_SENSITIVE: a primary loss exists but the lost set changes under descriptive extension

strata005_application.original_study_boundary: hosted scan timing was explicitly noisy, non-monotonic, and descriptive only
